references.text: The same formula is used to introduce the Lord's commands to the children of Israel through Moses.
A similar introductory formula where Moses is to speak to the children of Israel about the Lord's commandments.
The same command to speak to the children of Israel with the words of the Lord.
A similar formulation where Moses is instructed to speak to the children of Israel.
Moses receives a command to speak to Aaron's sons, the priests, with the words of the Lord.
A command to Aaron and his sons, the same recipients as in Leviticus 17:2.
The expression 'this is the word that the Lord has commanded' is used in a similar way.
The same formula: 'This is what the Lord has commanded.'
The expression 'this is the word that the Lord has commanded' is repeated here.
